name: Voxel Chunk Data Management and Residency
aliases: Voxel Chunk Compression and Residency Management
Far-Chunk Voxel Data Compression & Residency Management
definition: Residency tracks the memory state of a chunk: Resident (raw array present), Empty (no data), Uniform (single value), Compressed (encoded buffer).
summary: Voxel Chunk Data Management and Residency reduces memory footprint by tracking state transitions between raw, uniform, and compressed forms, prioritizing distant chunks via distance-keyed asynchronous compression.
